notablePrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to Kiki-Jiki.
description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask token enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {3}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {1}, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.
